source_units.text: I need to interpret groundwater diagrams in an environmental course.
Organize the relevant study into sessions.
Even if a day has several short sessions, their combined length must stay within 45 minutes.
Cover these exact topic labels: "Aquifer Recharge", "Hydraulic Head", "Well Drawdown".
Give each one at least 10 minutes over the whole plan.
Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-05, inclusive.
Give "Well Drawdown" at least 35 minutes in total; this is a firm extra requirement.
